UPS ePrice is one of the most important internal applications to deal with UPS Transport pricing modules. It contains Full and Low levels containers pricing information’s such as Customer Transport Quote and IAF details handled in this application. It deals customer and parcels pricing detailed information which is transported from one region to another region via UPS. UPS is the world’s largest company, with a 2022 revenue of $100.3 billion, and provides a broad range of integrated logistics solutions for customers in more than 200 countries and territories. Focused on its purpose statement, “Moving our world forward by delivering what matters,” the company’s employees embrace a strategy that is simply stated and powerfully executed: Customer First. People Led. Innovation Driven. UPS is committed to reducing its impact on the environment and supporting the communities and serve around the world.

Upgrade the current BIA application to latest .Net framework. (.Net Core)

Create APIs and Integrate external Azure solutions with services

Upgrade the current PHRS application to latest .Net framework. (.Net Core). To deliver new functionality, such as Repatriation Bed Board and OTPS, we will need to be on the latest version of .NET. The upgrade provides us with technical agility and scalability, meaning we can fully take advantage of cloud services/technologies as they require the latest version of .NET. Projects: Nestle, Budapest Hungary Nestle Professional Beverage Studio (NPBS)
NPBS Application is a web-based application that can easily set up beverage machines and monitoring the performance remotely. Through NPBS application we can connect any time anywhere with the machines around the world and assist the customers to drive the sales with promotions and seasonal beverages. Roles specific authorization ensures NPBS contains consistent and reliable data and automatic generated sales reports provide valuable insights for the powerful decision making. Reduce the operational cost and we can check remotely performing machines and access the event logs to allow technical support.
Responsibilities
Extensive design and development of modules/features in various modules of the application using C# and .NET.
Worked with Database Administrators to design tables and entities for various modules.
Created Data Access layer, Business layer and Presentation layer.
Reviewed code and refactored to achieve application optimal performance.
Implemented Dependency Injection to manage dependencies between objects.
Created configuration layer for configuration settings.
Created Extension methods for existing classes.
Responsible for change/develop application features based on the tickets raised by the end users.
Providing technical support to the end users while using the NPBS (Nestle Professional Beverage Studio) application if required.
Generating queries as per the user expectation and getting reports from the SQL database Providing constant technical support (L2/L3) for application to ensure optimal durability and reliability.
Extensively Working with Whole data base design and writing SQL Procedures using SQL Server 2008/2014(Stored Procedures, triggers, tables, Views)
Projects: British Telecom, UK MyBell BUP Changes
The Objective of this project is to promote the customers who use eCare websites of Bell and Virgin to switch their billing format from Paper Bills to eBills. This application emphasizes cost savings and environment protection by reducing paper usage. The system will display a flashy popup with an option to switch from Paper Bill to eBill to Customers on successful logon based on registered billing format.

The Roam Better banner is available to the following account type/sub types. Consumer Personal (Account type/subtype: I/R), Small Business (I/N), Small Business Personal (I/5), Corporate EPP (C/T), Corporate Concentric (C/7).if the subscriber is authorized then system shows this banner or else do not show this banner. The Roam Better Banner will be displayed for all countries in the travel section available today. The front end will display the Roam Better Banner when add a travel bundle is selected under the individual add on section of MyBell.
Responsibilities
Analyzed the business requirements and designed the services (REST) using C# and Web API
Developed new and modified existing stored procedures and tables using Entity Framework to include data in the payload as per the requirements.
Documented Web API details for Service Providers
Responsibilities include system designing, database designing and development using SQL Server, system testing and QC deployment Environment.
Projects: DSI, IND UCB Organization Manager 5.3/Xtelligent 5.3/DSI Komodo 5.3
UCB OM 5.3 is a web-based application used in paramedical organization and it relates the different types of entities and sends the configurations data to the MI and SG applications. These applications follow the Entities relation rules and configurations which are configured by the UCB OM applications. Entities contain the modules are Company, Sales Force, Sales area and Product, Employee and Customer, Postal Area, Geography, Regions. Home office users of paramedical organization uses this application and set the rules and configuration of the above entities, Organization’s Rep and DM,RM users, customers are going to be allocated based on the configurations assigned by the HO users in these applications UCB Xtelligent 5.3/Komodo 5.3 is a data load tool which contains interfaces to load client data to the database server. These interfaces are modified based on the client specifications in the requirement document and it’s doing data validation for each column of the tables before loading the data.
Responsibilities
Design and Development.
Writing C# code for class libraries
Writing queries and store procedures using SQL Server 2008
Requirement gathering from Manager, BRD and EA diagrams.
Responsibilities include system designing, database designing and development, system testing and QC deployment. Technical Skills: ASP.NET (C#), Webservices, WCF, LINQ, AJAX, MVC, MS-SQL Server (2005/ 2008), Sequoia, Oracle 10g Windows XP/2003 Server, Komodo tool, OM 5.1/5.3, MI (5.1/5.2).

Projects: AMFC. Healthcare, IND
The Keystone Mercy Health Plan (KMHP) has been operating several Medicaid books of business from its facilities, on Facets 4.21 platform. AmeriHealth Mercy Family of Companies initiated a project to consolidate its 7 Line Of Business into 3 to achieve ease of maintenance of its facets systems and to streamline their business functions. FACETS, a healthcare product widely used in the US Payer industry, is the core system implemented and maintained for running managed care business. AmeriHealth Mercy Family of Companies (AMFC) currently operates its lines of business in various states on different instances of Facets. Owing to the high level of similarity between the business processes of various Lobs, AMFC is currently considering consolidating the different instances of Facets across the eight Lobs
Responsibilities
Writing code in all layers
Writing queries, creating store procedures and views and SQL jobs
Requirements gathering directly from project Manager/client, making calls for discussions and meetings regarding projects.
Handing issues, development, and supporting/maintaining project.
Testing and deployment.
